meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Phone A Fangirl Calls, XG Answer Fan Calls, Kristen Bell, Bretman Rock & P1Harmony Play Fun Trivia & Games, John Krasinski & Aubrey Plaza Play Fun Trivia & Games, Thunderbolts, Ginny & Georgia & Cobra Kai Play Fun Trivia & Games
